query: SELECT c.id as companyId, c.name as company, COUNT(CASE WHEN p.currentStock > 0 THEN 1 END) as productsWithStock, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN p.currentStock > 0 THEN p.currentStock * p.avgCost ELSE 0 END),2) as stockValue FROM products p INNER JOIN companies c ON p.companyId = c.id WHERE p.active = 1 AND (p.isComposite = 0 OR p.isComposite IS NULL) GROUP BY c.id, c.name
